tacticalRules.974: When opp RB binds the wing defender then looks to the wing, LW must keep body on the wing pass and call half because half has not taken the wing runner.

tacticalRules.932: When the wing has the ball in a 2v2 and half has not called switch after the back cuts, wing defender must stay with the wing on the ball until switch.
tacticalRules.973: When ball reverses and inside help is already present, stay on your open wing rather than chasing middle.
